newsitem.title: USA: Corn harvest progress in Ohio remains limited.
newsitem.headline: Corn harvest progress in Ohio remains limited.

text.p: Farmers in Ohio made limited corn and soybean harvest progress during the week ended November 25, according to the latest crop weather report from the state's agricultural statistics service.
Soybean harvest was complete on 92 percent of the acreage, three points above the previous week and eight points behind the five-year average, the report said.
Corn harvesting jumped to 76 percent complete, up from 61 the previous week. That figure compared with the five-year average of 87 percent.
Over 90 percent of the corn crop had been harvested in the northwest district, while the north and west central districts have three-fourths of their crops harvested.
Wheat had emerged on 93 percent of the acreage, compared with 89 the previous week, 100 last year and the average of 98 percent.
The winter wheat crop was rated 69 percent good to excellent, 26 percent fair, four percent poor and one percent very poor.
